The Chinese characters for Jeremy

As a transliteration, Jeremy is usually written 杰里米 (Jié lǐ mǐ). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

杰
Jié
outstanding
里
lǐ
inside, a mile
米
mǐ
rice

Origin and meaning

Jeremy comes from Hebrew and means “God will uplift (form of Jeremiah)”.

About the name Jeremy

A form of Jeremiah, popularised in Britain by the actor Jeremy Irons.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Jeremy as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “God will uplift (form of Jeremiah)”, is part of the appeal.
